'''Goblins'''  in the [[God Wars Dungeon]] are troops for the [[Bandos]]ian army from the goblin tribe [[Rekeshuun]], fighting against the other monsters inside the dungeon. They are considerably stronger than most goblins found elsewhere and can be killed for [[killcount]].

==Drops==
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}

These goblins are all level 84, and can be found in the northwest (Bandos) corner of the centre area. They are not found in Bandos' encampment. They are weak against earth spells.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Early-Game Rebalance|date=16 February 2026}}
** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.
*** Tin stone spirit → Tin ore
*** Medium spiky bronze salvage → Bronze spear
*** Tiny bladed bronze salvage → Bronze hatchet
*** Small bladed bronze salvage → Bronze scimitar/Bronze off hand scimitar

* {{UL|type=update|update=Tuska Clean Up - This Week In RuneScape|date=18 August 2025}}
** The Sacrifice, Devotion, and Transfigure abilities have been removed from the God Wars Dungeon I loot table, and are now obtained by completing the One Piercing Note quest.

* {{UL|type=update|update=God Wars: Remastered|date=5 September 2012}}
** Graphical overhaul of God Wars Dungeon. 

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (13 May 2010)|date=13 May 2010}}
** Goblin death animations should now be a bit quicker.

* {{UL|type=update|update=God Wars Dungeon|date=28 August 2007}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* Prior to the [[Evolution of Combat]], the goblins carrying banners were never aggressive and would run from players when approached. As a result of this, it contradicted their examine text, which was "A soldier to the death." These goblins also had much lower hitpoints than the other goblins in the dungeon, only having 3 hitpoints.
